notes:
Account is building a ticket-deflection RAG for enterprise SaaS customers. Primary goals: 1) push high deflection rate without hurting CX, 2) keep per-query cost predictable at scale, 3) meet tight latency SLOs for agent/assist flows. Typical traffic: bursty (end-of-day ticket surges), sustained background indexing. Wants top-5 rerank precision as primary KPI (human-eval: >85% helpful top-5).

Customer comments: 'We need sub-200ms p95 on query path for agent suggestions — anything slower degrades agent adoption.' — Head of Support Ops.

Technical constraints: ~5M canonical docs to start, plans to grow to 50M+ (kb articles, transcripts, product docs). Embedding refresh cadence: nightly incremental, full reindex weekly. Must support real-time ticket enrichment (additions within 30s). Cost sensitivity high: target cost-per-online-query < $0.006 at 95th percentile for read-heavy workloads.

Preference: Dedicated GPU pool + private control plane (on-prem for some customers in regulated verticals). Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching/quantization to reduce unit cost while preserving reranker quality.

Quoted from ML lead: 'Show us reranker config + eval harness we can run internally; also show eviction/kv-cache behavior under concurrent reads.'
requirements_summary: RAG stack for support agent + deflection. Must: sub-200ms p95 end-to-end for agent suggest, top-5 rerank precision > 85% on internal evals, scale to 50M docs with nightly increments, ability to cascade fallback models to cheaper embeddings when under load, strict audit logs + residency. Prefers dedicated capacity for predictable latency and private deployment for regulated customers.
